description: Published tax transparency data for the Economics bundle's optional tax features: OECD Corporate Tax Statistics CbCR aggregates and statutory corporate income tax rates as published statistics, OECD forward-looking effective tax rates and EU Tax Observatory offshore-wealth and billionaire effective tax rate estimates as model estimates with method and edition, every edition a release vintage. Tax Justice Network indices are not implemented (licence) and public CbCR reports are link-only references. No own effective tax rate, ratio, rank or score, no blending, no filled jurisdiction or year, no currency conversion and no forecast.
